description: This Python source file provides utility functions for handling authentication, request validation, IP checking, size limits, and routing in a FastAPI-based proxy server for the litellm project. It includes mechanisms for security checks, model info extraction, and user/session handling relevant to proxy authentication and request filtering.

methods.name: Optional[str] _get_request_ip_address( request: Request, use_x_forwarded_for: Optional[bool] = False )
methods.description: Extracts the client's IP address from the request headers, considering X-Forwarded-For if specified.

methods.name: Tuple[bool,Optional[str]] _check_valid_ip( allowed_ips: Optional[List[str]], request: Request, use_x_forwarded_for: Optional[bool] = False, )
methods.description: Verifies if the client's IP address is within the allowed list.

methods.name: bool check_complete_credentials(request_body: dict)
methods.description: Checks if request body contains complete and valid credentials, rejecting suspicious models.

methods.name: bool check_regex_or_str_match(request_body_value: Any, regex_str: str)
methods.description: Checks if a value matches a regex or string exactly.

methods.name: bool _is_param_allowed( param: str, request_body_value: Any, configurable_clientside_auth_params: CONFIGURABLE_CLIENTSIDE_AUTH_PARAMS, )
methods.description: Determines if a parameter is permitted based on configuration.

methods.name: bool _allow_model_level_clientside_configurable_parameters( model: str, param: str, request_body_value: Any, llm_router: Optional[Router] )
methods.description: Checks if the model is allowed to use configurable client-side parameters.

methods.name: bool is_request_body_safe( request_body: dict, general_settings: dict, llm_router: Optional[Router], model: str )
methods.description: Performs multiple security checks to ensure the request body does not contain dangerous parameters.

methods.name: pre_db_read_auth_checks( request: Request, request_data: dict, route: str, )
methods.description: Performs pre-database read authentication and validation checks, including IP, size, and route restrictions.

methods.name: route_in_additonal_public_routes(current_route: str)
methods.description: Determines if a route is publicly accessible based on configuration and wildcard patterns.

methods.name: str get_request_route(request: Request)
methods.description: Extracts the route from the request, removing base URL prefix if present.

methods.name: bool check_if_request_size_is_safe(request: Request)
methods.description: Checks whether the incoming request's size falls within allowed enterprise limits.

methods.name: bool check_response_size_is_safe(response: Any)
methods.description: Checks whether the response size from a server falls within allowed enterprise limits.

methods.name: bytes_to_mb(bytes_value: int)
methods.description: Converts a size in bytes to megabytes.
